Unit 1.topic: be 动词与一般现在时
Unit 1.summary: 用 be 动词(am/is/are)介绍姓名、年龄、身份；用一般现在时描述习惯与状态。
examples: I am a new student.
She is polite and helpful.
We are in Class 2.

Unit 2.topic: 一般现在时(第三人称单数)与情态动词 can
Unit 2.summary: 主语为第三人称单数时动词加 -s/-es；用 can 表达能力。
examples: He plays the guitar every day.
She enjoys rock music.
I can play the piano.

Unit 3.topic: 物主代词与一般现在时
Unit 3.summary: 区分形容词性物主代词(my/your/his/her)与名词性物主代词(mine/yours/his/hers)。
examples: This is my father.
That book is mine.
Her hair is long.

Unit 4.summary: 可数名词有单复数，不可数名词常用 some/any；how many 接可数，how much 接不可数。
examples: I have some dumplings.
There is no milk in the fridge.
How many lanterns are there?

Unit 5.topic: 一般现在时与现在进行时；情态动词
Unit 5.summary: 一般现在时表示习惯事实，现在进行时表示正在发生；can/must 表示能力与义务。
examples: Pigeons can find their homes.
The dog is running now.
We must protect wild animals.

Unit 6.summary: 用一般现在时描述自然规律；用 be used to / for 表达用途。
examples: Plants make their own food.
We use water to grow plants.
Oxygen is for breathing.

Unit 1.topic: 一般现在时；形容词描述感受
Unit 1.summary: 用一般现在时表达对幸福、生活的看法；用形容词描述感受。
examples: Happiness is a choice.
The soup looks watery.
She feels happy.

Unit 2.topic: 一般将来时(be going to/will)；祈使句
Unit 2.summary: be going to 表示计划，will 表示预测；祈使句表示建议与鼓励。
examples: I am going to run a marathon.
She will cross the finish line.
Go for it!

Unit 3.topic: 可数与不可数名词；some/any；比较级
Unit 3.summary: 区分食物名词的可数与不可数；用 more/less 与形容词比较级描述。
examples: This beef is saltier than that.
I would like some porridge.
There is less sugar in it.

Unit 4.summary: 用 can 表示能力，may/might 表示可能；现在进行时描述正在发生的活动。
examples: You might see a butterfly.
I am reading a novel now.
May I join you?

Unit 5.topic: 一般现在时；形容词与副词；比较级
Unit 5.summary: 用形容词描述自然景观，副词修饰动作；比较级比较自然特征。
examples: The sky is soft and bright.
The water looks calm.
The night sky is more beautiful.

Unit 6.topic: 一般将来时(be going to)；情态动词；祈使句
Unit 6.summary: 描述旅行计划用 be going to；表达愿望与建议；祈使句提醒注意事项。
examples: We are going to travel south.
You must take a map.
Remember your passport.

Module 1.topic: 提建议(should/Let's/Why not/It's a good idea to)
Module 1.summary: 用 should、Let's、Why not、It's a good idea to 提出建议。
examples: You should practise speaking aloud.
Let's look it up in a dictionary.
It's a good idea to write down new words.

Module 2.summary: 比较两个人或两处地方时用比较级(taller than, wider than)。
examples: My town is smaller than Shanghai.
The river is wider than the road.
Cambridge is older than London.

Module 3.topic: 形容词/副词比较级与最高级
Module 3.summary: 比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者以上；The most... 结构。
examples: Football is more exciting than tennis.
This year we practise more carefully.
He is the best player in our team.

Module 4.summary: 用最高级(the fastest/the most comfortable)比较多种交通方式。
examples: The plane is the fastest way.
The train is the most comfortable.
Walking is the cheapest choice.

Module 5.summary: want to do / plan to do；give/pass/show + 人 + 物。
examples: I wanted to see the show.
He gave me a ticket.
She showed us the old teahouse.

Module 6.topic: 动词不定式作主语/宾补
Module 6.summary: It's + adj. + to do；allow/help + 人 + to do。
examples: It is important to protect animals.
The park allows people to get closer.
We work hard to save them.

Module 7.summary: 描述过去某一时刻正在发生的动作。
examples: Alice was sitting by the river.
She was thinking about the rabbit.
It was raining at that time.

Module 8.summary: 用 while 引导持续动作，when 引导突发动作。
examples: While I was riding, a car appeared.
I was trying to pick it up when it bit me.
He was running when he fell.

Module 9.summary: million/billion 与 hundred/thousand 的用法。
examples: The population is about 1.37 billion.
The city has two hundred thousand people.
It might snow tonight.
She may come tomorrow.
It might be sunny later.

Module 11.topic: 情态动词 must; 行为习惯表达
Module 11.summary: must 表示必须；描述不同文化的习俗。
examples: You must use a knife and fork.
They must wait for the host.
In China, we open gifts later.

Module 12.topic: 情态动词与祈使句(急救指令)
Module 12.summary: 祈使句用于指令；情态动词描述急救原则。
examples: Keep calm and stay still.
You must call for help.
Do not move the person.

Module 1.summary: 系动词后接形容词作表语，表示感觉与印象。
examples: The soup smells delicious.
It sounds wonderful.
She looks friendly.

Module 2.summary: 描述经历：have/has + 过去分词。
examples: I have entered a competition.
She has never been abroad.
Have you ever seen a tower?

Module 3.summary: 用 already/just 表完成，yet 表疑问与否定。
examples: The spaceship has just reached Mars.
We have already started the project.
They haven't arrived yet.

Module 4.summary: since 接时间点，for 接时间段，表示持续。
examples: I have felt ill since Monday.
We have played football for a year.

Module 5.summary: 描述至今为止的持续状态。
examples: Tintin has been popular for years.
I have watched the film twice.

Module 6.topic: 简单句的五种基本句型
Module 6.summary: 主谓、主谓宾、主系表、主谓双宾、主谓宾宾补。
examples: She collects stamps.
His hobby is sailing.
It makes me happy.

Module 7.summary: will/be going to 表计划；情态动词表建议与义务。
examples: I am going to join the camp.
You should prepare your passport.
The trip will last a month.

Module 8.summary: 宾语从句用陈述语序；that 表陈述，if/whether 表是否。
examples: I believe that we are here.
I don't know if it will rain.

Module 9.summary: 询问是否或细节时用宾语从句。
examples: I wonder whether she will come.
I don't know why she was sad.

Module 10.summary: 表达想法、看法时用 that 引导宾语从句。
examples: I think that he is a good presenter.
He said that the show was on air.

Module 1.summary: 复习一般现在时、一般过去时、一般将来时、现在进行时、现在完成时、过去进行时。
examples: I have seen the Grand Canyon.
The Great Wall was built long ago.
We will travel next week.

Module 2.summary: 时间状语从句用 as soon as、until 等引导。
examples: My family goes out as soon as the holiday begins.
We waited until the flag rose.

Module 3.summary: though 表让步；so...that 表结果。
examples: Though it was hard, she never gave up.
He worked so hard that he succeeded.

Module 4.summary: although/though 引导让步状语从句。
examples: Although I was alone, I felt fine.
He managed it although it was difficult.

Module 5.topic: 祈使句；if 条件句(主将从现)
Module 5.summary: 祈使句表示规则；if 引导条件句，主句用一般将来时。
examples: Don't cross that rope!
If you go to London, visit the museum.

Module 6.summary: if 引导真实条件句，主句用 will + 动词原形。
examples: If I finish first, I will go out.
If you tell the truth, you will feel better.
The book is still read today.
His ideas are loved by many.

Module 8.topic: 一般过去时/一般将来时被动语态
Module 8.summary: was/were + 过去分词；will be + 过去分词。
examples: She was chosen for the team.
He was invited to the competition.
The game will be held here.

Module 9.topic: 现在完成时与情态动词被动语态
Module 9.summary: have/has been + 过去分词；can/must be + 过去分词。
examples: The computer has been used for years.
Books will be replaced by the Internet?

Module 10.summary: that/which 引导定语从句修饰物。
examples: I have photos that I took in Australia.
The game that they like is football.

Module 11.summary: who 修饰人，which 修饰物。
examples: He's the boy who won the prize.
The photo which we liked was hers.

Module 12.summary: 掌握环保相关词汇；用被动语态描述环保行动。
examples: Rubbish is divided into groups.
Plastic is recycled into new things.

Module 1.summary: 复习可数/不可数名词、冠词与数词用法。
examples: We took a flight by plane.
The pilot landed at the airport.

Module 2.summary: 掌握人称、物主、反身与指示代词。
examples: This is our school; that one is theirs.
Help yourself to some tea.

Module 3.summary: 形容词修饰名词，副词修饰动词；used to 表示过去习惯。
examples: Life used to be hard.
Life is easier today.

Module 4.summary: 表达必须、许可与可能；规则与建议。
examples: You must set off early.
You should bring a rope.
We may rest here.

Module 5.summary: 在健康话题中综合运用多种时态。
examples: I have been ill for a week.
I will take more exercise.

Module 6.summary: 描述西方餐桌礼仪用被动语态；表达观点用宾语从句。
examples: Knives and forks are used for Western food.
I think that we should be polite.

Module 7.summary: 表达语言学习观点；用被动语态描述英语使用。
examples: English is spoken all over the world.
I think that English is useful.

Module 8.summary: 展望未来、表达愿望与计划。
examples: I will study at a university.
I believe that our future is bright.
